projects.name: VoiceOps AI
projects.description: Production multi-tenant AI voice agent SaaS. Businesses deploy AI receptionists that handle inbound and outbound PSTN calls, book appointments in real time, and sync with Google Calendar. 14 API routers, 60+ endpoints, 3 Stripe billing plans, 3 APScheduler jobs for reminders, reschedule offers, and no-show follow-ups.

projects.name: LexCall
projects.description: AI phone management system for a law firm. ElevenLabs AI answers inbound calls, collects caller information through natural conversation, classifies call type, and auto-generates a branded intake PDF emailed to the firm. Staff dashboard with call recordings, transcripts, and daily analytics. Live at phone.manninglaw.chat.

projects.name: Founder's Lab
projects.description: Multi-agent AI co-founder assistant embedded in a live Bubble.io SaaS platform. LangGraph agents validate business ideas, generate 7-step entrepreneurship roadmaps, run market research via DuckDuckGo, find experts via Google Places, and generate logo concepts with DALL-E 3. Real users, real traction.

projects.name: Trajectry
projects.description: AI-powered career intelligence platform. Candidates upload their CV and complete a voice interview with Akira, an AI agent. They're matched against 414K jobs and ~6,500 companies by fit score, discover hiring-team contacts via Apollo, and track their full outreach pipeline. LangGraph workflow v3, hexagonal architecture.

projects.name: StructureIQ
projects.description: AI construction document analyzer for structural engineers. Ingests multi-hundred-page PDFs, classifies pages by type (framing, foundation, schedules, hardware), extracts specs via GPT-4o text and vision, deduplicates hardware callouts, and generates a branded report. Handles 5 title block formats from different engineering firms.
